dataset: Municipal Master Plans (PDM) - Porto district target municipalities
method_rules: Use only official municipal, DGT/SNIT/SNIG, or official legal-publication sources.
Prefer original municipal PDM vector data over harmonized national products.
Preserve source classifications and attributes; do not normalize classes.
Only legally effective plans are final; draft/revision procedures are documented but excluded until effective.
Prefer EPSG:3763 and do not transform unless source CRS is unambiguous.
Retain original legal regulation and publication references when obtainable.
